name: (required - rows with a blank name are skipped)

variants: a <variant> is a label plus an optional (rarity, cost) — e.g. +1 (uncommon, 500gp)
either half of the parens may be omitted — +1 (uncommon) inherits the base cost, Masterwork (150gp) inherits the base rarity
a bare label with no parens — Ornate — inherits both
each variant becomes its own selectable item, named "<base name> <label>"
